sources.title: HeightField Erode 3.0
observedContract: iterative simulation from a start frame
separate height, sediment, debris, flow and flow-direction outputs
transport distance depends on spread iterations and feature size

sources.title: HeightField Erode Hydro
observedContract: separate water, debris, sediment, eroding-height and reference-bedrock layers
sediment capacity is expressed per unit moving water
deposition moves excess sediment into debris

sources.title: HeightField Slump
observedContract: erosion requires sediment and entrained layers
material outflow beyond the heightfield edge is an explicit boundary policy
removal rate is an explicit material sink

limitations: The SideFX pages are mutable product documentation rather than immutable source revisions.
Their layer and boundary design is mature-system evidence, not proof that the N08 toy equations are physically calibrated.
N08 executable evidence is an independently written bookkeeping counterexample; it does not execute Houdini.
